keyEvents.text: Own Goal by Eduardo Bauermann, Pachuca. Pachuca 0, Guadalajara 1.
Jorge Berlanga (Pachuca) is shown the yellow card.
Oussama Idrissi (Pachuca) is shown the yellow card.
Carlos Moreno (Pachuca) is shown the yellow card.
Omar Govea (Guadalajara) is shown the yellow card.
José Castillo Pérez (Guadalajara) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Pachuca 1, Guadalajara 1. Oussama Idrissi (Pachuca) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Salomón Rondón.
